scope: Conditional independent confirmation of an already registered development method; no new method search and no replacement of the original frozen435-entry study.
decision_after: All three-start diversity and capacity readouts complete; no further fitting or hyperparameter edits
threshold_reason: At least approximately within0.5percentage points of the pre-existing83.95% nativeOracle32 development mean and no slower than its27.43s component time. Both quality and time must pass; fitting cost remains additional.
selection: Among eligible passing points select highest three-start mean accuracy, then lowest time, then lexical method name; choose at most one predictor.
test_population: If triggered, create fresh MNLI source groups excluded from all existing study/prior-study groups, approximately2048examples, with deterministic seed2026101601. Freeze method/control/data hashes before any new generated outcome.
controls: Matched exact-subsetOracle at selected horizon andLR
timing: Three fresh exact-weight repetitions per trained adapter if the confirmation is triggered; original training/readout costs and offline dependencies remain explicit.
budget: No new research methods. Skip the entire confirmation if no point passes both gates or insufficient time remains. Confirmation results are a separate prospectively frozen extension, never inserted into the original435-entry analysis.
